articles.summary: For eight decades, the American Airlines base maintenance facility in Tulsa, Oklahoma (Tech Ops – Tulsa), has stood at the center of the airline’s technical operations, evolving into the world’s largest commercial aircraft maintenance base and a cornerstone of the airline’s commitment to safety and reliability.
articles.title: American Airlines Tulsa base maintenance facility celebrates 80 years of excellence

articles.summary: The new agreement will unlock 35 million gallons (132 million liters) of SAF over three years, resulting in nearly 300,000 metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) emissions reductions.
articles.title: American Airlines and Google sign record-breaking sustainable aviation fuel agreement

articles.summary: American Airlines and Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) today debuted the brand-new Terminal C pier, a significant milestone in the historic transformation of American’s largest and most important hub. The new Terminal C pier features nine new electronic boarding gates, equipped with industry-leading technology, and elevates the customer experience with new concessions, seating, restrooms and a spacious, modern design, representing the future of Terminal C.
articles.title: Expanding its largest hub: American Airlines unveils 9 new gates at DFW with enhanced customer experience

articles.summary: In this episode of Tell Me Why, Chief Commercial Officer Nat Pieper reflects on nearly three decades in the airline industry — including a surprising family tie to American’s earliest roots — and explains the “commercial virtuous circle” that guides how we build our network, elevate the customer experience and strengthen revenue and loyalty.
articles.title: Tell Me Why: ‘The American product is something people want to buy’ — Nat Pieper

articles.title: American Airlines to webcast annual meeting of stockholders

articles.summary: n its centennial year, American Airlines will further its legacy as the largest airline with the most flights between the United States and Mexico, the Caribbean and Latin America (MCLA) with a milestone 100 destinations served in the region.
articles.title: American to serve milestone 100 destinations in Mexico, the Caribbean and Latin America with two new cities from Miami

articles.summary: American Airlines and Tarrant County College announced a new partnership today, creating a direct pathway for aspiring aviation maintenance technicians (AMTs) to careers at American.
articles.title: American Airlines, Tarrant County College team up to tap top North Texas talent
